MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.

3. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

4. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

5. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.

6. When practising Reading for Understanding, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Understanding.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Understanding.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Understanding.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Understanding.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Understanding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.

3. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

4. B — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

5. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Understanding.

7. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading for Fluency; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

8. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading for Understanding; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

9. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

10. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
